findings.issue: יֹצֵא is a qal active masculine singular construct participle, the head (each one who goes out); צָבָא is its complement. «saliente ejército» makes the army the head that goes out.
Passive participle takes a 3ms suffix (his numbered ones). «sus» fits a plural noun but does not show that singular possessor beside the 3mp suffixes.

notes: Other tokens match, including singular שָׁנָה as año and ל-phrases kept as a/en.
